summary: 周二，铜价回吐了周一人工智能推动的全部涨幅，因为在最近的人工智能暴跌期间抛售金属的投资者几乎没有回归的兴趣，而且交易员不断将美国库存转移到中国。纽约早盘交易中，Comex 12 月交割的铜价下跌 3.5%，至每磅 5.437 美元（每吨 11,985 美元）。该水平的结算价将是 3 月 24 日以来的最低水平。该合约周一结算价为 5.634 美元，上涨 2.7%，但远低于 Nvidia 恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官后创下的盘中高点 5.787 美元。周二的下跌使铜价比历史纪录低 21%
content:
周二，铜价回吐了周一人工智能推动的全部涨幅，因为在最近的人工智能暴跌期间抛售金属的投资者几乎没有回归的兴趣，而且交易员不断将美国库存转移到中国。纽约早盘交易中，Comex 12 月交割的铜价下跌 3.5%，至每磅 5.437 美元（每吨 11,985 美元）。该水平的结算价将是 3 月 24 日以来的最低水平。该合约周一结算价为 5.634 美元，上涨 2.7%，但远低于 Nvidia 恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官后创下的盘中高点 5.787 美元。周二的下跌使铜价比 9 月 9 日创纪录的 6.889 美元下跌 21%，从技术上讲，这是一个熊市。该金属今年已下跌 3%，11 月份则下跌 16%。据路透社报道，伦敦金属交易所三个月期铜在官方交易中下跌 3.5%，至每吨 12,054 美元，此前曾一度跌破 12,000 美元。周一该股上涨了 5.3%。 11 月 12 日黄仁勋辞职后，在人工智能暴跌期间出售大宗商品的投资者并没有急着回来。 Panmure Liberum 分析师汤姆·普莱斯 (Tom Price) 对路透表示：“这些投资者并未完全重新投入事件发生前的头寸，其中包括大宗商品敞口。”他表示，许多人认为铜的波动性太大，正在削减大宗商品的投资，以专注于人工智能股票。杭州成联实业的基本金属交易员Aces Zhou告诉彭博社：“现在市场做空铜的原因有多种。”
他表示，除了人工智能的叙述之外，随着铜离开美国，贸易流开始逆转，支撑铜价两年上涨的因素正在瓦解。加息和强势美元加剧了阻力。据彭博社报道，市场完全预计美联储 12 月会议将上涨 25 个基点，这将是今年的第二次会议，而根据 BMO 资本市场的数据，美元指数处于 2025 年 3 月以来的最高水平。美国金属运往中国 现货市场依然紧张，但资金流已经压倒了市场，BMO分析师上周参加上海亚洲铜周后写道。可见的交易所库存仅能满足大约两天的消费量，而进口到中国的洋山溢价在一个月内从每吨不到 100 美元攀升至 500 美元左右。 BMO表示，这些溢价，加上纽约和伦敦价格之间的差距缩小，促使贸易商预订了估计3万吨至10万吨的美国阴极，以便直接运往中国。这些金属存放在美国西海岸的交易所仓库外，大约需要两周时间才能抵达。 BMO表示，发货量的重要性不在于吨位，而在于它们所发出的信号：贸易商正在对一项关税决定失去信心，该决定将使美国库存与世界其他地区隔绝。
中国业内人士预计唐纳德·特朗普总统将放弃对精炼铜征收关税的计划，而西方参与者仍倾向于征收关税。 BMO预计，抛售将持续下去，直到华盛顿方面发出关税意向或价格大幅下跌以影响供应，可能在每吨10,000美元至11,000美元的范围内。该银行表示，托克的成本曲线显示，通过溶剂萃取和电解提取生产的铜中约有 10% 已经亏损，亏损额约为 13,000 美元。 BMO 坚持其中期结构性看涨观点。冶炼厂就 2027 年处理费进行了挤压谈判，矿工向冶炼厂支付的精矿加工费用仍然相差甚远。安托法加斯塔报道

【原文 English Original】
Copper gave back all of Monday’s artificial intelligence-fuelled gains on Tuesday as investors who dumped metals during the recent AI rout showed little appetite to return, and traders kept moving US stockpiles to China. Comex copper for December delivery fell 3.5% to $5.437 a pound ($11,985 a tonne) in morning trade in New York. A settlement at that level would be the lowest since March 24. The contract settled at $5.634 on Monday, up 2.7% but well off the session high of $5.787 reached after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive. Tuesday’s drop leaves copper 21% below its record settlement of $6.889 on September 9, technically a bear market. The metal is now down 3% this year and 16% in November. Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange was down 3.5% at $12,054 a tonne in official trading after briefly ducking below $12,000, Reuters reports. It had jumped as much as 5.3% on Monday. Investors who sold commodities during the AI rout that followed Huang’s resignation on November 12 are not rushing back. “These investors are not fully reengaging the positions they had pre-event, which includes commodity exposure,” Panmure Liberum analyst Tom Price told Reuters. Many have decided copper is too volatile and are cutting commodity exposure to concentrate on AI stocks, he said. “There are now multiple reasons for the market to short copper,” Aces Zhou, a base metals trader at Hangzhou Chenglian Industrial, told Bloomberg. Beyond the AI narrative, he said, trade flows are starting to reverse as copper leaves the United States, and the factors that supported the metal’s two-year rally are unravelling. Rate hikes and a strong dollar add to the headwinds. Markets are fully pricing a quarter-point increase at the Federal Reserve’s December meeting, which would be the second this year, Bloomberg reports, and the dollar index is at its highest since March 2025, according to BMO Capital Markets. US metal heads to China The physical market remains tight, but financial flows have overpowered it, BMO’s analysts wrote after attending Asia Copper Week in Shanghai last week. Visible exchange inventories cover only about two days of consumption, and the Yangshan premium for imports into China climbed from under $100 a tonne to around $500 in a month. Those premiums, together with a narrowing gap between New York and London prices, have prompted traders to book an estimated 30,000 to 100,000 tonnes of US cathode for direct shipment to China, BMO said. The metal, held outside exchange warehouses on the US west coast, takes about two weeks to arrive. The shipments matter less for the tonnage than for what they signal, BMO said: that traders are losing confidence in a tariff decision that would keep US stockpiles sealed off from the rest of the world. Chinese industry players expect President Donald Trump to drop plans for duties on refined copper, while Western participants still lean towards a tariff being imposed. BMO expects the selloff to extend until Washington signals its tariff intentions or prices fall far enough to hit supply, potentially in the $10,000 to $11,000 a tonne range. Trafigura’s cost curve shows about 10% of copper produced by solvent extraction and electrowinning is already losing money at around $13,000, the bank said. BMO stands by its structurally bullish medium-term view. Smelters squeezed Talks on 2027 treatment charges, the fees miners pay smelters to process concentrate, remain far apart. Antofagasta has reportedly offered around minus $200 a tonne, while China’s Tongling has signalled about minus $80 could be acceptable, according to BMO. This year’s benchmark was set at zero, already a record low, and BMO estimates some Chinese smelters break even on a cash basis at around minus $90. A deeply negative 2027 benchmark could speed up output cuts, especially as falling sulphuric acid prices erode by-product income. Mine supply remains tight. Global copper mine production fell 1% year on year in September and is down 1% over the first nine months of 2026, the International Copper Study Group said in its latest monthly bulletin. Output from Chile slumped 15% and Peru 9% in the month, more than offsetting gains in Indonesia, China and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Refined demand fell 2% from a year earlier, slightly more than supply, leaving the refined market in deficit for the month, though it remains in surplus for the year to date. Miners give back gains Copper stocks reversed much of Monday’s rally. Freeport-McMoRan fell 5% at the New York open, cutting its market value to $68 billion, and Southern Copper lost 4% to $117 billion. Teck Resources dropped 4% to $25 billion, while BHP slipped 2% to $174 billion and Rio Tinto 2% to $125 billion. The five New York-listed heavyweights shed about $15 billion in the first minutes of trading, after adding more than $25 billion on Monday. In London, Antofagasta dropped 7%, Anglo American almost 6% and Glencore 4%, while Poland’s KGHM fell 7%. In Toronto, First Quantum Minerals lost 6%, Lundin Mining and Hudbay Minerals 5% each and Ivanhoe Mines 4%. BHP this week outlined plans to spend up to $17.4 billion to roughly double copper output in South Australia to about 650,000 tonnes a year by 2040, with a final investment decision expected in the first half of 2027. First Quantum Minerals and Panama opened formal negotiations on Monday over the Cobre Panama mine, shut since 2023, after the company accepted the government’s five conditions for talks, including recognition that Panama owns the mineral resource. Trader Trafigura has taken full control of the $260 million La Farola copper-gold project in Chile, buying the remaining 50% of owner Minera Altair as it moves from trading concentrate into mine development. In Santiago, the price slump is threatening President José Antonio Kast’s budget plans , as copper accounts for about half of the country’s exports. (With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

黄一再表示，中国正在追赶甚至赢得人工智能竞赛，美国的出口管制是徒劳的，是“我们做过的最愚蠢的事情”，限制向中国销售先进芯片最终将削弱美国的技术领导地位。他表示，那些抵制他的想法的人——他称之为“对华鹰派”——是不爱国和非美国人的。这些论点在思想上是空洞的，是典型的傲慢，在战略上是鲁莽的，而且是为了英伟达的商业利益而明显自私。更糟糕的是，它们反映了更广泛的硅谷心态，将企业利润与美国国家利益混为一谈。考虑一下矛盾。如果中国正在赢得人工智能竞赛，为什么中国企业如此渴望英伟达的先进芯片？如果Claude、ChatGPT等美国AI模型正在失去技术优势，那么为什么Kimi、阿里巴巴等中国顶级AI公司还要寻求通过大规模蒸馏来提取自己的能力呢？如果美国的出口管制是徒劳的，为什么北京要投入大量资源来规避这些管制？向美国最重要的战略对手提供支撑美国霸主地位的技术如何可能增强美国的竞争优势？黄先生恶毒地将“对华鹰派”斥为戴着“耻辱徽章”，这使得捍卫美国技术优势每当干扰企业利润时就显得可耻。
他的论点在其自身逻辑的荒谬性下崩溃了。事实上，这是硅谷的自我实现预言，一种循环论证，将其自身商业决策的后果转化为重复这些决策的理由。中国的技术进步仍然严重依赖美国的半导体设计、先进的人工智能芯片、计算基础设施和技术专长。如果无法获得这些能力，北京在开发尖端人工智能方面将面临更大的障碍。中国的科学家和工程师有能力

The Death of Logic and Sanity in Silicon Valley bbert@hudson.org Tue, 11/24/2026 - 13:49 SVG Commentary Nov 24, 2026 Washington Times The Death of Logic and Sanity in Silicon Valley Our technology giants are helping China challenge American supremacy   Miles Yu Senior Fellow and Director, China Center Miles Yu Commentary Caption The headquarters of NVIDIA in the Silicon Valley, Santa Clara, California, November 6, 2025. (Getty Images) Toggle Table of Contents Contents Contents Share to Twitter Twitter Share to Facebook Facebook Share to LinkedIn LinkedIn Share to E-mail E-mail Print Print Something has gone terribly wrong in Silicon Valley . The industry that made America the world’s technological superpower has produced executives whose commercial ambitions increasingly collide with national security. Their dealings with communist China expose an astonishing paradox: American technology companies help China catch up with the United States, then warn that China is catching up, and finally use that warning to demand permission to sell China even more advanced technology. No one is more vocal in advancing this lunacy than Nvidia’s now-reinstated CEO Jensen Huang . Mr. Huang’s latest scandal has been sensationalized, focusing on his illicit relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese national and a former executive of Singapore-based Megaspeed . Yet the bigger issue is Mr. Huang’s absurd ideas about China and its artificial intelligence industry. Mr. Huang has repeatedly argued that China is catching up with or even winning the AI race, that American export controls are futile or “the dumbest thing we’ve ever done” and that restricting advanced chip sales to China will ultimately undermine American technological leadership. He says those resisting his ideas — whom he labels “ China hawks” — are unpatriotic and un-American. These arguments are intellectually vacuous, characteristically arrogant, strategically reckless and remarkably self-seeking for Nvidia’s commercial interests. Worse, they reflect a broader Silicon Valley mentality that confuses corporate profits with America’s national interest. Consider the contradictions. If China is winning the AI race, why are Chinese companies so desperate for Nvidia’s advanced chips? If American AI models such as Claude and ChatGPT are losing their technological edge, why do China’s top AI firms, such as Kimi and Alibaba, seek to extract their capabilities through large-scale distillation? If American export controls are futile, why does Beijing devote extraordinary resources to circumventing them? How can supplying America’s foremost strategic adversary with the technologies underpinning American supremacy possibly strengthen America’s competitive advantage? Mr. Huang’s vicious dismissal of “ China hawks” as wearing a “badge of shame” makes defending American technological superiority sound disgraceful whenever it interferes with corporate profits. His arguments collapse under the absurdity of their own logic. In fact, this is Silicon Valley’s self-fulfilling prophecy, a circular argument that converts the consequences of its own commercial decisions into justification for repeating them. China’s technological progress remains critically dependent on American semiconductor designs, advanced AI chips, computing infrastructure and technical expertise. Without access to these capabilities, Beijing would face far greater obstacles in developing cutting-edge AI. China’s scientists and engineers are capable, and its government invests enormous resources in innovation. Yet its relentless pursuit of American technology reveals how much its technological ambitions still depend on foreign breakthroughs. Mr. Huang’s corporate behavior is also in question. Multiple reports indicate that Megaspeed has purchased more than $4.8 billion in advanced Nvidia AI chips since June 2024 and has erased the records of these transactions from its books. American authorities have investigated suspected diversion through Southeast Asian intermediaries. Reports have also raised questions about Ms. Huang’s suspected ties to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia general counsel Tim Teter reportedly contacted Commerce Department investigators, citing clearance from Undersecretary Jeffrey Kessler, regarding the Megaspeed investigation. Nvidia denies wrongdoing and says it stopped supplying Megaspeed in June 2025, but recent reports dispute the denial. Congress and law enforcement should investigate the Megaspeed affair, examine possible interference with export-control enforcement and close loopholes involving third-country intermediaries, remote computing access and sensitive technology licensing. Proven violations deserve serious penalties. Nvidia is hardly alone. Consider Advanced Micro Devices CEO Lisa Su, Mr. Huang’s distant cousin. In 2016, under her leadership, AMD entered into a technology-licensing agreement worth approximately $293 million, plus royalties, with Chinese partners affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences. The arrangement transferred valuable x86-compatible processor technology and first-generation Zen intellectual property into China’s industrial ecosystem. The available record indicates the transaction was lawful. Its strategic wisdom deserves scrutiny. Why should American companies help develop China’s indigenous computing capabilities and then warn Americans about the technological challenge they helped create? Cisco provides another cautionary example. Falun Gong practitioners accused the company of supplying technologies that helped China’s Golden Shield surveillance system identify and track religious believers. Cisco disputed the allegations, and this year the U.S. Supreme Court dismissed the lawsuit, holding that the Alien Tort Statute does not allow aiding-and-abetting liability against corporations. Yet the controversy illustrates the risks of American technology becoming entangled with authoritarian surveillance. The Chinese Communist Party systematically mobilizes civilian technology for military modernization, intelligence operations and political control. U.S. executives advocating greater access to technology for China must confront these strategic consequences. America’s technological supremacy rests on decades of innovation, enormous investment and hard-won expertise. Allowing these advantages to strengthen its principal strategic adversary threatens the foundations of American security. Silicon Valley has perfected a vicious cycle of strategic folly: Sell advanced American technology to China , often knowingly and furtively through a third, surrogate country such as Singapore. Watch Beijing close the gap. Warn Americans that China is catching up. Declare export controls futile. Demand permission to sell even more advanced technology to China . Repeat. Each turn enriches Silicon Valley , strengthens Beijing and erodes America’s technological supremacy. The closer China gets, the louder the alarm — and the louder the alarm, the greater the pressure to sell China more. Eventually, the prophecy fulfills itself: Silicon Valley helps China catch up, warns America that China is catching up, and uses that warning to help China catch up even faster, until America loses the race its own technology giants helped China win. In other words, Silicon Valley has lost its mind. In explaining his support for Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, President Trump has said Mr. Huang has learned his lessons. Let us hope these lessons learned will help Silicon Valley regain its sanity. Read in the Washington Times. Enjoyed this analysis? title: Why the Shenzhen Summit Does Not Mark a New “Tripolar” Order
zh_title: 为什么深圳峰会没有标志着新的“三极”秩序

为什么深圳峰会没有标志着新的“三极”秩序 bbert@hudson.org 星期二, 11/24/2026 - 13:21 SVG 评论 2026 年 11 月 23 日 国家利益 为什么深圳峰会没有标志着新的“三极”秩序 虽然美国、中国和俄罗斯超越了其他大国，但它们缺乏将世界划分为势力范围的能力。齐波拉·弗里德 (Tsiporah Fried) 客座高级研究员 齐波拉·弗里德 (Tsiporah Fried) 评论说明文字 中国国家主席习近平、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京于 2026 年 11 月 19 日在中国深圳出席亚太经合组织 (APEC) 领导人非正式会议。 (Getty Images) 切换目录 目录 内容 分享到 Twitter Twitter 分享到 Facebook Facebook 分享到 LinkedIn LinkedIn 分享到电子邮件 电子邮件 打印 打印 唐纳德·特朗普、习近平之后数小时，弗拉基米尔·普京在深圳发表和平宣言，俄罗斯导弹和无人机袭击了乌克兰的电力基础设施。特朗普周五在华盛顿发表讲话，讨论了他与普京的单独会谈，并表示他相信俄罗斯总统希望结束战争。当被问及乌克兰在这样的解决方案中可以期待什么安全保障时，他回答说：“我不想谈论安全保障，因为我们必须首先达成协议。”然而，对于基辅来说，这一序列提出了一个更根本的问题：乌克兰总统如何能在不保证俄罗斯不会重新点燃冲突的情况下同意结束战争？
这种对比体现了深圳峰会的承诺和假设。三个核大国的领导人有充分的理由进行直接对话，因为每个国家都有能力威胁其他国家的安全。但这并不是三个平等权力的关系。俄罗斯对中国的依赖日益加深，同时其核地位和军事能力也持续存在。三方会议的意义不在于三位领导人达成的共识，而在于会议召开的事实。其象征意义很大，但其实质性成果似乎有限。联合声明没有做出具体承诺，没有解决任何根本冲突，也没有定义谈判框架。尽管如此，它对于为三个大国之间的对话提供直接的政治表达可能具有价值。这种对话是否能产生比外交象征意义更多的东西仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。阅读《国家利益》。喜欢这个分析吗？订阅哈德森的时事通讯，了解我们的最新内容。电子邮件 查看更多订阅选项 外交政策 国际组织

Why the Shenzhen Summit Does Not Mark a New “Tripolar” Order bbert@hudson.org Tue, 11/24/2026 - 13:21 SVG Commentary Nov 23, 2026 The National Interest Why the Shenzhen Summit Does Not Mark a New “Tripolar” Order While the United States, China, and Russia outclass other powers, they lack the reach to divide the world into spheres of influence.   Tsiporah Fried Visiting Senior Fellow Tsiporah Fried Commentary Caption Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin attend a meeting at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders in Shenzhen, China, on November 19, 2026. (Getty Images) Toggle Table of Contents Contents Contents Share to Twitter Twitter Share to Facebook Facebook Share to LinkedIn LinkedIn Share to E-mail E-mail Print Print Hours after Donald Trump , Xi Jinping , and Vladimir Putin issued their Declaration toward Peace in Shenzhen, Russian missiles and drones struck Ukraine ’s electricity infrastructure . Speaking in Washington on Friday, Trump discussed his separate talks with Putin and said he believed the Russian president wanted to end the war. Asked what security guarantees Ukraine could expect in such a settlement, he replied : “I don’t want to talk about security guarantees because we got to get a deal first.” For Kyiv, however, the sequence raises a more fundamental question: how can a Ukrainian president agree to end a war without some guarantees that Russia won’t reignite the conflict? That contrast captures both the promise and the presumption of the Shenzhen Summit . The leaders of the three nuclear powers have compelling reasons to talk directly since each possesses the capacity to threaten the security of the others. Yet this is not a relationship of three equal powers. Russia’s growing dependence on China sits alongside its continued nuclear status and military capacity. The significance of the trilateral meeting lies less in what the three leaders agreed on than in the fact that it took place at all.  Its symbolism is considerable, but its substantive outcome appears limited. The joint declaration establishes no specific commitments, resolves none of the underlying conflicts, and defines no negotiating framework. It may nevertheless have value in giving direct political expression to dialogue among the three powers. Whether that dialogue can produce anything more than diplomatic symbolism remains an open question. Read in The National Interest. Enjoyed this analysis? title: From horsepower to firepower, Japan draws auto suppliers into major arms buildup
zh_title: 从马力到火力，日本吸引汽车供应商大规模军备建设
summary: 日本横手——多年来，日本制造商 Aster 通过为丰田汽车供应零部件赚钱。但随着该国汽车工业在激烈的中国竞争中举步维艰，Aster 在国防技术领域找到了新的利基市场。其电动机为美国军事技术公司 Anduril 制造的无人机提供动力，自去年进入该领域以来，国防业务收入已增长至十分之一。 “无人机是一项更好的业务，”首席执行官本乡武信 (Takenobu Hongo) 在谈到 Aster 对国防承包的支持时说道，长期以来，这个国家的公民一直对国防承包持谨慎态度。
content:
日本横手——多年来，日本制造商 Aster 通过为丰田汽车供应零部件赚钱。但随着该国汽车工业在激烈的中国竞争中举步维艰，Aster 在国防技术领域找到了新的利基市场。其电动机为美国军事技术公司 Anduril 制造的无人机提供动力，自去年进入该领域以来，国防业务收入已增长至十分之一。 “无人机是一项更好的业务，”首席执行官本乡武信(Takenobu Hongo)在谈到Aster对国防承包的拥护时说道，长期以来，这个几十年来和平主义塑造的国家的公民一直对国防承包持谨慎态度。 “目前，对我们来说，汽车电机的利润并不高。”根据对包括政府官员、公司高管和首相高市早苗内阁顾问在内的九人的采访，东京鼓励日本众多汽车供应商加入该国自二战以来最大规模的军事建设，Aster 的战略重点是其举措的一部分。高市政府希望，利用现有的工业供应链将加速日本的安全转型，加强其防御能力，抵御来自核邻国中国、俄罗斯和朝鲜的威胁。重新军备的努力得到了东京主要安全伙伴美国的支持，美国正在敦促盟国增加武装部队支出。
相关日本内阁批准创纪录的国防预算，旨在威慑中国 日本2026财年的国防预算草案比2025年增长9.4%。这一建设也为日本曾经世界领先的汽车工业提供了一条重要的多元化途径。日本汽车制造商协会的数据显示，到 2025 年，日本工厂的汽车产量将比十年前减少近 90 万辆。路透社首次报道了该行业刚刚进军国防部门的详细信息，以及负责监督国防部采购的采购、技术和物流局 (ATLA) 如何为其提供支持。一名机构官员和四名高管表示，该部门一直在评估 Aster 等供应商，将它们与军火公司配对，并提供新的资金来源。高市内阁顾问 Koko Kato 在帮助引导行业转型方面也发挥了作用。她说，如果国防和汽车之间存在协同作用，汽车制造商“应该抓住机会”。加藤告诉路透社，她在二月份监督了一项单独的贸易部计划的修改，旨在帮助汽车供应商多元化进入国防和其他行业。 ATLA 在回答路透社的问题时表示，它是帮助寻求进入国防工业的公司的联络点，并将继续与其他政府部门合作，鼓励新进入者。高市办公室没有回应问题。
制造业强国高市政府承诺在年底前制定新的安全战略，其中包括支持日本二战战败后最初解散的军火工业的路线图。该计划建立在日本作为制造业强国的传统之上。尽管汽车工业最近出现衰退，日本仍然是世界第三大汽车生产国。该行业每年生产超过 800 万辆汽车，并提供十分之一的就业机会，约有 70,000 家公司生产大量零部件。自 2025 年政治争端以来，中国已将日本附近的海军存在“正常化”。

【原文 English Original】
YOKOTE, Japan — For years, Japanese manufacturer Aster made its money supplying parts for Toyota vehicles.  But as the country’s auto industry struggles in the face of fierce Chinese competition, Aster has found a new niche in defense technology. Its electric motors power drones built by U.S. military technology company Anduril, and defense work has grown to a tenth of revenue since it entered the sector last year. “Drones are a much better business,” chief executive Takenobu Hongo said of Aster’s embrace of defense contracting, which has long been viewed warily by citizens of a country shaped by decades of pacifism. “At the moment, for us, automotive motors aren’t very profitable.” Aster’s pivot is part of a move by Tokyo to encourage Japan’s many auto suppliers to join the country’s biggest military buildup since World War II, according to interviews with nine people, including government officials, company executives and an advisor to Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s Cabinet. Takaichi’s government hopes that tapping existing industrial supply chains will speed up Japan’s security transformation as it bolsters its defenses against threats from nuclear-armed neighbors China, Russia and North Korea. The rearmament efforts are backed by Tokyo’s chief security partner, the United States, which is pressing allies to increase spending on armed forces. Related Japan’s Cabinet OKs record defense budget that aims to deter China Japan's draft defense budget for fiscal 2026 is up 9.4% from 2025. The buildup also offers an important diversification avenue to Japan’s once world-leading auto industry. The country’s factories built nearly 900,000 fewer vehicles in 2025 than a decade earlier, according to the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association.  Reuters is reporting for the first time details of the industry’s nascent push into the defense sector and how it is supported by the Acquisition, Technology & Logistics Agency (ATLA), which oversees defense ministry procurement. The department has been evaluating suppliers like Aster, pairing them with arms firms and offering new funding streams, an agency official and four executives said. An advisor to Takaichi’s Cabinet, Koko Kato, has also played a role in helping steer the industry’s transformation. If there is a synergy between defense and autos, carmakers “should take the opportunity,” she said. Kato told Reuters she oversaw changes in February to a separate trade ministry program aimed at helping auto suppliers diversify into defense and other industries. ATLA said in response to Reuters questions that it serves as a point of contact to help companies seeking to enter the defense industry and that it will continue to work with other government departments to encourage new entrants.  Takaichi’s office did not respond to questions.  Manufacturing powerhouse Takaichi’s government has pledged to lay out a new security strategy by year-end, including a road map for bolstering an arms industry that was initially dismantled after Japan’s World War II defeat.  The plan builds on Japan’s legacy as a manufacturing powerhouse. Despite its auto industry’s recent decline, Japan is still the world’s third-largest vehicle-producing nation. The industry manufactures more than 8 million vehicles a year and supports one in 10 jobs, with some 70,000 companies making an enormous array of components. Related China has ‘normalized’ naval presence near Japan since political spat of 2025 Given its scale, the massive Chinese flotilla that included coast guard vessels alongside navy warships may have had Taiwan’s maritime neighbor Japan in its sights, military experts say. Skills prized in auto manufacturing, such as precision and electronics manufacturing, as well as quality control, are relevant to arms production, said Pontus Haggstrom, a Japan-based adviser to the auto industry and former CEO of Stellantis Japan.  The industry “also knows how to produce complex products reliably and at scale,” he added.  The case for Japan to draw on domestic manufacturing has also grown as American arms makers struggle to replenish arsenals depleted by conflicts in the Middle East and Europe. Tokyo was the destination for about a tenth of U.S. weapon exports in 2021-25, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute. “Customers tell us their traditional suppliers don’t have the capacity,” said Hiroko Suzuki, the chief executive of car-engine component maker Kyowa Industrial, which has received a growing number of orders for prototype drone engines. While Kyowa has long made missile-related components, the defense sideline now comprises 10% of annual sales, up from 3% in spring 2025. Some auto suppliers are also eyeing opportunities to sell to U.S. and European military contractors.  ATLA has been holding events in Tokyo to connect Japanese suppliers with potential Western clients. Some 48 Japanese companies from various industries took part in a September event, twice as many as last year, the procurement agency said. Drone rush ATLA, which in October launched a funding program for the development and testing of new military technology, has encouraged some auto suppliers to produce components for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The agency has said it is willing to provide millions of dollars in support to projects that advance to prototype development. The upcoming national security strategy is expected to outline plans to arm Japan with fleets of attack and interceptor drones of the kind that have reshaped warfare elsewhere. But domestic industrial production is tiny: The country exported just over 1,100 drones last year, compared with the roughly 123,000 UAVs sold to overseas clients by neighboring Taiwan, according to trade figures compiled by Taiwan’s Research Institute for Democracy, Society and Emerging Technology. While fiscal constraints are likely to force Tokyo to rethink some existing orders for missiles and aircraft, such is Japan’s need for UAVs that drone-related spending will likely be ringfenced, according to an official familiar with budget plans.  Toru Tokushige, CEO of Japanese dronemaker Terra Drone, said ATLA officials recently introduced him to Kaaz, a maker of racing car parts that has developed a small gasoline-powered aircraft engine. Tapping auto suppliers could significantly increase Japan’s drone-building capacity, he said. A spokesperson for Kaaz said that it has consulted with ATLA and is actively pursuing the development of engines for military drones.  Ishikawa Energy Research, a drone startup that attended ATLA’s September forum, is also seeking military applications for its aircraft.  The firm’s UAVs are used mainly for agricultural purposes such as crop spraying, founder Mitsuru Ishikawa told Reuters. But the former Honda engineer said his gasoline-powered drones could also transport heavier defense equipment or conduct longer-range military reconnaissance missions than more common battery-powered models. The firm, which is based in the industrial town of Ota, has already tapped into the sprawling local auto supply chain that feeds carmaker Subaru, with more than 50% of the components in its drones coming from auto suppliers. Ishikawa does not think those firms will object to his military ambitions, in part because Subaru, which is better known globally for its sporty cars, already has a major defense arm. The company has built military aircraft, including attack helicopters, for Japan’s Self-Defense Forces for decades.  Subaru expects defense-related demand to grow and intends to capture those business opportunities, a spokesperson said, declining to give specific forecasts.   Overcoming a taboo The auto industry’s shift to defense contracting is for now largely limited to smaller parts makers, according to five officials and analysts. Japan’s big three automakers — Toyota, Honda and Nissan — have shown little appetite for a defense tilt. They still have substantive businesses in China, which has criticized Japan’s arms buildup. They have also long been wary of the reputational risks that come with the defense sector.  “The company’s basic position at this point is that we will not do anything related to defense,” senior Toyota executive Hiroyuki Ueda said at a results briefing earlier this month. Nissan declined to comment on potential defense work, while Honda said in response to questions that it has no specific plans to enter the sector.  That hesitancy also filters down to their closest suppliers. Mitsubishi Electric chief financial officer Kenichiro Fujimoto told Reuters his company was pursuing a new military drone venture and that tapping auto supply chains made sense. However, he added, automakers were quite resistant to their suppliers doing anything outside the industry. “There’s this odd attitude sometimes, like, ‘Don’t do any work other than ours,'” he said. Aster’s Hongo was also wary that some of his company’s roughly 100 staff might object when he gathered them at his factory in the northern Japanese town of Yokote in November 2025 to announce that Anduril wanted to use their motors.  Instead, the 71-year-old executive received a warm reception. “Everyone was more like: ‘Wow, that’s impressive!’” he said of the meeting.  The commercial opportunities in defense, as well as growing public concern about Japan’s security challenges, would lure many more companies, Hongo predicted.  “In Japan now, there are very few people who think this is somebody else’s problem,” he said. Reporting by Tim Kelly, John Geddie, Daniel Leussink and Maki Shiraki

title: US blacklists Megaspeed hours after Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
zh_title: 黄仁勋重返英伟达数小时后，美国将 Megaspeed 列入黑名单
summary: 黄仁勋刚刚重新掌管英伟达，山姆大叔就将新加坡云提供商 Megaspeed 列入了贸易黑名单，这家丑闻使黄仁勋丢掉了工作。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 已将 Megaspeed 及多家附属企业列入其实体名单，限制其获取美国技术，同时对涉嫌将先进 GPU 转移到中国的调查正在进行中。最终规则 [PDF] 于周一下午提交，并计划于周三在《联邦公报》上公布，其中列出了七名
content:
黄仁勋刚刚重新掌管英伟达，山姆大叔就将新加坡云提供商 Megaspeed 列入了贸易黑名单，这家丑闻使黄仁勋丢掉了工作。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 已将 Megaspeed 及多家附属企业列入其实体名单，限制其获取美国技术，同时对涉嫌将先进 GPU 转移到中国的调查正在进行中。最终规则 [PDF] 于周一下午提交，并计划于周三在《联邦公报》上公布，其中列出了新加坡、马来西亚和泰国的七家企业，包括 Megaspeed 的所有者 Swiftdata 和马来西亚子公司 Speedmatrix。同样受到华盛顿关注的还有中国云计算巨头阿里巴巴位于新加坡的子公司 Apex Enterprise Solutions。 BIS 表示，这些企业存在将先进计算硬件转移给未经美国政府授权的接收者或应用程序的重大风险。任何想要向这七家公司提供受美国出口管制的货物的人都需要获得许可证，其申请将受到“拒绝推定”的约束。尽管是在周一宣布这一消息的，但美国政府对 Megaspeed 的兴趣远远早于黄仁勋私生活的曝光。
在上周发布的一份联合声明中，美国司法部和商务部证实，后者在监控半导体出口管制潜在违规行为时发现可疑活动，已于 2024 年对 Megaspeed 展开调查。调查人员要求 Nvidia 提供与 2025 年 5 月向 Megaspeed 直接和间接销售相关的记录，GPU 巨头在下个月将这家新加坡公司列入其内部“禁止销售”名单。美国调查人员随后在新加坡执法官员的陪同下走访了 Megaspeed 的办公场所并采访了其时任首席执行官 Alice Huang。此后，司法部牵头开展刑事调查。与 Nvidia 老板没有亲属关系的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是一名女商人，据说詹森与她有染。本月早些时候，他承认自己有婚外情，尽管他从未点名过这位 Megaspeed 高管的名字。据报道，美国情报官员怀疑她代表中国情报部门工作，尽管北京方面否认了间谍指控。 Megaspeed坚称其业务合法，并表示Alice Huang于去年8月正式离开公司。它还聘请了外部律师进行内部调查。 Nvidia 的黄仁勋在公司流放了整整 11 天。
周一，这家芯片制造商的董事会一致投票决定恢复其联合创始人的总裁兼首席执行官职务，不到一周前，董事会主席哈维·琼斯(Harvey Jones)表示，不可能让他重返公司。在包括埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)在内的一些硅谷大腕进行游说活动以及白宫进行了一些更为重要的干预之后，董事会出现了180度大转变。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周一对 CNBC 表示，他亲自说服了英伟达董事让黄重回岗位。英伟达董事会表示，已收到美国政府高级官员关于黄仁勋回国对国家安全影响的保证。然而，华盛顿仍有很多人对黄有疑问。 Nvidia 老板将与三人坐下来

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang was barely back in charge of Nvidia when Uncle Sam slapped Megaspeed –­ the Singaporean cloud provider at the center of the scandal that cost him his job ­­– on its trade blacklist. The US Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has added Megaspeed and a number of affiliated businesses to its Entity List, restricting their access to American technology amid an ongoing investigation into the suspected diversion of advanced GPUs to China. The final rule [PDF], filed Monday afternoon and scheduled for publication in the Federal Register on Wednesday, names seven businesses across Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand, including Megaspeed's owner, Swiftdata, and Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix. Also in Washington's crosshairs is Apex Enterprise Solutions, a Singapore-based subsidiary of Chinese cloud computing giant Alibaba. BIS said the businesses posed a significant risk of diverting advanced computing hardware to recipients or applications not authorized by the US government. Anyone looking to supply the seven companies with goods subject to US export controls will need a license, with applications subject to a "presumption of denial." Despite the timing of Monday's announcement, the US government's interest in Megaspeed predates the revelations about Jensen Huang's private life by some considerable margin. In a joint statement issued last week, the Departments of Justice and Commerce confirmed that the latter had opened an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 after spotting suspicious activity while monitoring potential violations of semiconductor export controls. Investigators requested records from Nvidia relating to both direct and indirect sales to Megaspeed in May 2025, and the GPU giant put the Singaporean outfit on its internal "no sell" list the following month. US investigators, accompanied by Singaporean law enforcement officials, subsequently visited Megaspeed's premises and interviewed its then-CEO, Alice Huang. The Justice Department has since taken the lead on the criminal investigation. Alice Huang, who is not related to the Nvidia boss, is a businesswoman with whom Jensen was said to be having an affair – he admitted to extramarital infidelity earlier this month , although he never name-checked the Megaspeed exec. According to reports, US intelligence officials suspected she was working on behalf of Chinese intelligence, though Beijing has rejected the espionage allegations. Megaspeed maintains that its business is lawful and says Alice Huang formally left the company in August last year. It has also enlisted outside lawyers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia's own Huang lasted all of 11 days in corporate exile. The chipmaker's board unanimously voted to reinstate its co-founder as president and CEO on Monday, less than a week after board chairman Harvey Jones indicated that bringing him back wasn't on the cards. The U-turn followed a lobbying campaign by some of Silicon Valley's biggest names, including Elon Musk , and some rather more consequential intervention from the White House. President Donald Trump told CNBC on Monday that he had personally persuaded Nvidia's directors to give Huang his job back. Nvidia's board said it had received assurances from senior US government officials regarding the national security implications of Huang's return. There are still plenty of people in Washington who have questions for Huang, however. The Nvidia boss is due to sit down with three congressional committees on December 1, with the chipmaker's general counsel, Tim Teter, scheduled to face lawmakers the following day. Nvidia has also established a board-level committee to oversee national security and export control compliance, putting its trade compliance personnel under the supervision of three directors. Nvidia shareholders may be delighted to have Jensen back, but the returning CEO has barely a week to prepare for his congressional grilling over the affair that helped bring about his departure. ®

title: CiDi unveils new cabless battery mining truck plus agentic AI solution at bauma CHINA
zh_title: CiDi在bauma CHINA推出新型无缆电池采矿车和代理人工智能解决方案
summary: CiDi 是一家专注于重型嵌入式人工智能的香港上市科技公司，今天在上海 bauma CHINA 2026 上推出了自动驾驶汽车、工业机器人和智能系统的扩展产品组合。新产品组合包括 VEGA，一款与智子汽车共同开发的专用 4 级（L4）自动驾驶重型卡车； CDK155，第二代无电缆电动自动采矿卡车； CT17-1S是一款地下钻孔机器人，旨在减少人们暴露在危险工作环境中的机会。 CiDi 还推出了由人工智能驱动的挖矿代理 Yura 及其 V2X
content:
CiDi 是一家专注于重型嵌入式人工智能的香港上市科技公司，今天在上海 bauma CHINA 2026 上推出了自动驾驶汽车、工业机器人和智能系统的扩展产品组合。新产品组合包括 VEGA，一款与智子汽车共同开发的专用 4 级（L4）自动驾驶重型卡车； CDK155，第二代无电缆电动自动采矿卡车； CT17-1S是一款地下钻孔机器人，旨在减少人们暴露在危险工作环境中的机会。 CiDi 还推出了人工智能挖矿代理 Yura，以及 V2X 露天挖矿解决方案和 IPUr 智能板载计算单元。此次展示标志着 CiDi 在其更广泛的重型体现人工智能战略下首次全面展示其三个业务领域——自动驾驶、任务机器人以及智能硬件和服务。这些技术共同将自动化扩展到单个车辆之外，以连接不同工业环境中的设备、人员和操作工作流程。
IM 编辑总监 Paul Moore 和产品分析师 Yvetta Tang； bauma CHINA 首席执行官 Albert Hu 表示：“通过这个集成的产品组合，我很高兴看到我们将重型嵌入式人工智能的优势扩展到广泛的工业运营中的愿景成为现实——从露天矿的自主运营到地下深处的钻探和挖掘以及公共道路上的货运运输。通过将自主技术引入这些不同的环境，我们正在实现我们的目标，即让工业运营更安全、更高效、生产力更高。”慈迪。 CiDi 不断扩大的产品组合将自主技术引入了广泛的重型应用，从露天采矿到地下钻探和挖掘以及公共道路货运。它将专用自动设备与现有车队的智能解决方案相结合。 CDK155：第二代无线电动自动采矿卡车 针对露天采矿，CiDi 推出了 CDK155，这是其第二代专用无线自动采矿卡车。这款100吨级电动汽车取消了传统的驾驶室，其设计、电子架构、感知系统和安全功能专为自动驾驶而开发。 CDK155的额定有效载荷为100吨，电池容量为1,056千瓦时。
支持充电和电池更换，仅需 18 分钟即可将电量从 20% 充电至 80%。其他功能包括预测性维护、地形适应和多车辆协调。据CiDi介绍，与同级传统车辆相比，CDK155的载重能力提高了10%，零部件减少了15%，车辆使用寿命提高了20%，维护和运营成本降低了10%。据 IM 了解，这辆卡车由陕西的一家合作伙伴制造，但采用 100% CiDi 设计——第一辆卡车已经制造完毕，并将很快前往新疆的客户矿山进行测试。 Yura：用于智能矿山运营的人工智能代理在 bauma CHINA 2026 上，CiDi 还推出了 Yura，据称这是采矿业首款人工智能采矿代理。 Yura 是在 CiDi 已建立的 MetaMine 平台的基础上开发的，旨在使复杂的采矿作业更加智能且更易于管理。通过自然拉

【原文 English Original】
CiDi, the Hong Kong-listed technology company specialising in heavy-duty embodied AI, today unveiled an expanded portfolio of autonomous vehicles, industrial robots and intelligent systems at bauma CHINA 2026 in Shanghai. The new portfolio includes VEGA, a purpose-built Level 4 (L4) autonomous heavy-duty truck developed with Zhizi Auto; the CDK155, a second-generation cabless electric autonomous mining truck; and CT17-1S, an underground drilling robot designed to reduce people’s exposure to hazardous working environments. CiDi also introduced Yura, an AI-powered mining agent, alongside its V2X open-pit mining solution and IPUr Intelligent Onboard Computing Unit. The showcase marks CiDi’s first comprehensive presentation of its three business areas – Autonomous Driving, Task Robotics, and Intelligent Hardware & Services – under its broader heavy-duty embodied AI strategy. Together, these technologies extend automation beyond individual vehicles to connect equipment, people, and operational workflows across diverse industrial environments. IM Editorial Director Paul Moore with Yvetta Tang, Product Analyst; and Qingxiang Geng, MetaMine Application Specialist, at bauma CHINA “With this integrated portfolio, I am excited to see our vision of extending the benefits of heavy-duty embodied AI across a broad range of industrial operations becoming a reality – from autonomous operations in open-pit mines to drilling and excavation deep underground and freight transportation on public roads. By bringing autonomous technologies into these diverse environments, we are delivering on our goal which is to make industrial operations safer, more efficient and more productive,” said Albert Hu, CEO of CiDi. CiDi’s expanding portfolio brings autonomous technologies to a broad range of heavy-duty applications, from open-pit mining to underground drilling and excavation and public-road freight transportation. It combines purpose-built autonomous equipment with intelligent solutions for existing vehicle fleets. CDK155: a second-generation c abless electric autonomous mining truck For open-pit mining, CiDi introduced the CDK155, its second-generation purpose-built cabless autonomous mining truck. The 100 t class electric vehicle eliminates the conventional driver’s cabin, with its design, electronic architecture, perception systems and safety features developed specifically for autonomous operations. CDK155 has a rated payload capacity of 100 t and a battery capacity of 1,056 kWh. Supporting both charging and battery swapping, it can recharge from 20% to 80% in as little as 18 minutes. Other capabilities include predictive maintenance, terrain adaptation and multi-vehicle coordination. According to CiDi, compared with conventional vehicles in its class, CDK155 offers a 10% increase in loading capacity, 15% fewer components, a 20% improvement in vehicle service life and a 10% reduction in maintenance and operating costs. IM understands the truck is being built by a partner in Shaanxi but to a 100% CiDi design – the first unit has already been manufactured and will go to a customer mine in Xinjiang for testing soon. Yura: an AI-powered agent for intelligent mine operations At bauma CHINA 2026, CiDi also introduced Yura, which it says is the mining industry’s first AI-powered mining agent. Developed on the foundation of CiDi’s established MetaMine platform, Yura is designed to make complex mining operations more intelligent and easier to manage. Through natural-language instructions, mine operators can communicate production objectives directly to Yura. The agent interprets requests, breaks them down into actionable tasks, coordinating and dispatching equipments – autonomous haul trucks, electric shovels, and drilling machines across the mine. By orchestrating multiple stages of mining operations – from drilling, blasting and loading to haulage, dumping and energy replenishment – Yura shifts mine management from people coordinating individual machines to an AI agent intelligently managing operations across the entire mine. V2X: connecting vehicles, infrastructure and personnel in open-pit mines Complementing mine-level intelligence, CiDi’s V2X solution enables real-time coordination among vehicles, roadside infrastructure, personnel and cloud-based systems. The solution supports millisecond-level direct communications across four dimensions: vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V), vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I), vehicle-to-person (V2P) and vehicle-to-cloud (V2C). Applications include collision warnings, blind-spot alerts, curve warnings and coordinated operations between excavators and autonomous trucks. Personnel safety terminals such as TAG provide two-way alerts and emergency stop functions, including in areas with limited or unavailable network connectivity. CiDi said the solution has been deployed at more than 35 mines across China, with nearly 5,000 units installed. CT17-1S: extending automation to underground mining The CT17-1S marks a significant step forward, bringing CiDi’s automation to excavation and drilling activities further down to the underground operations. Developed for challenging underground environments characterised by unstable rock formations, heavy dust, excessive noise and potentially hazardous gases, the CT17-1S integrates remote operation with semi-autonomous excavation and autonomous drilling capabilities. Its functions include precision positioning, path following, automated drill-pattern execution and multi-machine coordination. By enabling remote and autonomous drilling operations, the CT17-1S helps keep people away from hazardous underground working faces, significantly reducing their exposure to operational risks. Powered by CiDi’s multimodal perception technology and heavy-duty world models, the robot can navigate and avoid obstacles in low-light underground environments without satellite positioning. It can also connect to MetaMine to coordinate with autonomous mining trucks, ground-support equipment and mine dispatch systems. IPUr: bringing intelligent capabilities to existing vehicle fleets While CiDi continues to advance autonomous operations, it also recognises that many customers still operate conventional, human-driven fleets. To support their transition towards greater automation, CiDi showcased IPUr, its factory-installed Intelligent Onboard Computing Unit, designed to bring L4-level perception and safety capabilities to existing engineering and commercial vehicles. The solution enables operators to enhance the intelligence and safety of their current fleets while providing a pathway towards broader automation over time. Gravicortex: A Unified Technology Platform Connecting Vehicles, Robots and Operations At the core of CiDi’s expanding portfolio is Gravicortex, its proprietary heavy-duty embodied AI technology platform. Serving as the common technological foundation for all three business areas – Autonomous Driving, Task Robotics, and Intelligent Hardware & Services – Gravicortex enables capabilities and operational data to be shared across products and applications. This interconnected architecture creates a continuous feedback loop in which advances in one business area can enhance the capabilities of others, supporting the development and scaling of autonomous solutions across diverse heavy-duty industrial environments. The platform combines heavy-duty world models, domain-specific foundation models and vision-language-action (VLA) models to support autonomous decision-making and coordination among vehicles, robots, roadside infrastructure and cloud-based systems. It is designed to support millisecond-level coordination across heterogeneous fleets at the 1,000-vehicle scale. These capabilities are brought together in mining through MetaMine, CiDi’s intelligent mining platform, which connects equipment, operational workflows and management systems in a unified operating environment. Designed to accommodate equipment from different manufacturers, powertrain configurations and operational functions, MetaMine enables operators to coordinate equipment and manage processes spanning excavation, haulage, dumping, energy replenishment and maintenance. MetaMine has served more than 40 mines globally, with over 1,000 pieces of equipment connected to the platform simultaneously during peak periods, according to CiDi. The same underlying technology capabilities are also being extended into autonomous freight transportation. CiDi’s solutions now cover industrial park logistics, border crossings, port-to-rail intermodal transportation, short-haul bulk cargo transportation and cross-border freight. Notable deployments include the China-Vietnam Puzhai Border Port project, involving autonomous container truck customs clearance, and the Chengdu International Railway Port project, which supports commercial operations involving both human-driven and autonomous vehicles. By the end of October 2026, CiDi had recorded more than 500 cumulative deliveries and outstanding orders for its autonomous freight business. Scaling commercial deployment through asset-light partnership model CiDi’s commercialisation strategy is built around an asset-light partnership model that brings together the complementary expertise of technology providers, vehicle manufacturers and fleet operators. Under this model, CiDi focuses on autonomous driving technologies, integrated solutions and fleet management systems. OEM partners are responsible for vehicle engineering and manufacturing, while customers own and operate their fleets. Beyond its role as a technology provider, CiDi continues to work closely with customers and partners, providing technical support and technology upgrades throughout deployment and operation. This division of responsibilities allows each participant to focus on its core strengths, while enabling CiDi to concentrate its resources on technology development and innovation without taking on the capital requirements and operational responsibilities associated with owning and managing vehicle fleets. During bauma CHINA 2026, CiDi also signed a series of agreements with mining and industrial partners in Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia and Anhui, further extending its autonomous solutions into mine management and daily operations. “Our capabilities in autonomous mining and freight transportation have been demonstrated through real-world deployments. With this expanded portfolio, we are bringing the benefits of heavy-duty embodied AI to more industrial applications, helping take people out of hazardous working environments and making operations safer and more efficient. We see significant opportunities to support mining and industrial operators globally as they increasingly embrace automation to enhance safety and efficiency as well as reducing operation costs,” said Albert Hu. Looking ahead, CiDi aims to extend its technologies into more international mining and industrial markets. Its capabilities in autonomous operations under limited network connectivity, compatibility with equipment from multiple manufacturers, integrated charging and battery-swapping solutions, and specialised electric equipment are designed to address the diverse requirements of mining operations worldwide. By bringing autonomous driving, task robotics and intelligent hardware together on a shared technology platform, CiDi aims to support the industry’s transition towards safer, more connected and increasingly autonomous heavy-duty operations. title: SANY unveils battery electric SET260E 240 t class mining truck

content:
在本周的 bauma CHINA 展会上，三一重工推出了许多有趣的产品和技术，但其中的重头戏无疑是 SET260E，这是一款采用 1,500 伏平台的 240 吨电池电动矿用卡车。三一重工的大型混合动力矿用卡车（尤其是SET150S和SET220S）引起了很多人的兴趣，并且拥有不少运营商。在bauma CHINA上，三一重工还展示了95吨级SRT100S混合动力刚性自卸车，据称这是世界上第一辆双发动机和直接电机驱动的混合动力刚性自卸车。 SRT100S 由三个电动机驱动，没有变速箱。两台发动机和一个牵引电池提供动力，发动机保持在最有效的范围内，制动能量由电机回收。三一重工预计燃油节省率超过20%。但SET260E将其牢牢带入全电动大型刚性卡车领域；显然，它成为了徐工全电动 XDE260E 的直接竞争对手，后者也在此次活动中正式推出，随后正在进行广泛的测试并最终交付给 Fortescue 和其他公司。三一重工的SET260E被誉为“全球最大”的纯电动矿车——仅靠电池动力就可以运载240吨。该公司表示，其磷酸铁锂电池是为重型采矿而开发的：在 1,500 伏平台上提供 4,130 千瓦时的电量，充电功率高达 9 兆瓦，30 分钟内从 10% 充至 90%，可用于六个多小时的运输。作为比较，卡特彼勒 793 XE Early Learner 的有效负载为 227 吨。
其他亮点包括超过 3 MW 的连续电力制动：首先是再生，无缝切换到电阻制动；前轴湿式制动器，后轴组合行车和驻车湿式制动器；能够承受矿井条件下的振动和冲击的电池组；集成热管理；功率元件高压直接驱动；加上牵引力控制、自动有效负载称重和 360° 摄像头视图。三一重工本周推出的下一款产品是 SKT165Ei 无缆自动电动矿用卡车，被誉为业界首款带湿式制动器的 100 吨级电池电动宽体卡车。 SKT165Ei 是一款电池电动宽体矿用卡车，从一开始就专为自动驾驶而设计，没有驾驶室。三一重工表示，去掉驾驶室后，有效载荷比提高了12%。它在 800 伏平台上运行，配有 2C 快速充电电池，充电时间不到 35 分钟。自主运输系统负责装载、运输和倾倒，并通过云控制平台进行调度和监控。该无电缆模型的其他亮点包括带有中央驱动器的大功率动力总成；电动制动加湿式制动器，用于负载下坡运输；具有云调度和集成监控功能的自主运输系统；即使在网络覆盖较弱的情况下也能够完成负载-运输-转储周期。
该车型还配有 SKT115Ei 自主电动宽体矿用卡车，这是一款配备全自动驾驶系统的 70 吨级电动宽体卡车，值得注意的是，所有这些自动驾驶车型均使用三一重工自己的 AHS，而不是第三方系统。 三一重工：“SKT115Ei 是世界上第一款具有不间断供电功能的 70 吨级电池电动宽体卡车，它是为自动驾驶而设计的。融合传感器可感知前方 150 m 以上，识别 40 m 外的小障碍物，并在雨、雪、雾和灰尘中继续工作，LiDAR、GNSS 和惯性数据相结合，可实现连续厘米级定位、切换。

【原文 English Original】
At bauma CHINA this week, SANY has a number of interesting product and technology launches but the big hitter is definitely the SET260E, a 240-tonne battery-electric mining truck on a 1,500-volt platform. SANY has seen a lot of interest, and has quite a few operators, for its large hybrid mining trucks – notably the SET150S and SET220S – and at bauma CHINA it also has the 95 t class SRT100S hybrid rigid dump truck, it says the world’s first hybrid rigid dump truck with twin engines and direct motor drive. The SRT100S is driven by three electric motors with no gearbox. Two engines and a traction battery supply the power, with the engines held in their most efficient range and braking energy recovered by the motors. SANY puts the fuel saving at more than 20%. But the SET260E brings it firmly into the all electric large rigid truck space; and obviously gives it a direct competitor to XCMG’s all electric XDE260E, which has also been officially launched at the event ahead of its ongoing extensive testing and eventual delivery to Fortescue and others. SANY’s SET260E is hailed as the “world’s largest” battery electric mining truck – carrying 240 tonnes on battery power alone. It says its lithium iron phosphate battery was developed for heavy-duty mining: 4,130 kWh on a 1,500-volt platform, charging at up to 9 MW and going from 10 to 90% in 30 minutes, for more than six hours of hauling. As a comparison, Caterpillar’s 793 XE Early Learner has a 227 t payload. Other highlights include electric braking of more than 3 MW continuous: regenerative first, with a seamless switch to resistor braking; wet brakes on the front axle, and combined service and parking wet brakes on the rear axle; a battery pack built to withstand vibration and impact in mine conditions; integrated thermal management; high-voltage direct drive of power components; plus traction control, automatic payload weighing and 360° camera view. Next on SANY’s launch list this week is the SKT165Ei cabless autonomous electric mining truck, hailed as the industry’s first 100 t class battery-electric wide-body truck with wet brakes. The SKT165Ei is a battery-electric wide-body mining truck built for autonomous operation from the outset, with no driver’s cab. SANY says that removing the cab raises the payload ratio by 12%. It runs on an 800-volt platform with a 2C fast-charge battery and recharges in under 35 minutes. An autonomous haulage system handles loading, hauling and dumping, with dispatch and monitoring through a cloud control platform. Other highlights for this cabless model include a high-power powertrain with central drive; electric braking plus wet brakes for loaded downhill hauls; an autonomous haulage system with cloud dispatch and integrated monitoring; and the ability to complete the load-haul-dump cycle even with weak network coverage. This model is complemented by the SKT115Ei autonomous electric wide-body mining truck, a 70-t class electric wide-body truck with a full autonomous driving system – noting that all these autonomous models are using SANY’s own AHS as opposed to a third party system. SANY: “The SKT115Ei is the world’s first 70-tonne-class battery-electric wide-body truck with uninterrupted power delivery, and it is built to drive itself. Its fused sensors see more than 150 m ahead, pick out small obstacles from 40 m away and keep working in rain, snow, fog and dust. LiDAR, GNSS and inertial data are combined for continuous centimetre-level positioning, switching automatically when satellite signals are blocked. The truck is dispatched and monitored from the cloud, and completes loading, hauling and dumping even where network coverage is weak.” It has two domain controllers bringing 400 TOPS computing-power and functional-safety requirements; fused perception vis LiDAR, cameras and radar cover 360° around the truck; fused positioning at centimetre-level, even when satellite signals are blocked; vehicle-cloud coordination and on-board intelligence with cloud dispatch and monitoring; plus redundancy via vehicle-to-vehicle links and on-board perception to cross-check each other. In excavators, SANY has its SY4000E electric mining excavator, “China’s first” dual-motor hydraulic mining excavator driven by two 700 kW electric motors. The SY4000E is a 400-tonne-class hydraulic mining excavator with a 22 m³ bucket. The two independently driven 700 kW motors power the machine, and it can keep working if one motor is out of service. SANY supplies it together with the power infrastructure it needs, from the substation to the cable reel on the machine. In more detail, the motors have an electronically controlled multi-pump, multi-valve hydraulic system and the machine offers fully electronically controlled hydraulics with flow of up to 6,000 L/min. It also has a3D assisted-digging system with centimetre-level accuracy, payload weighing, electronic fencing and driver monitoring, plus a 360° view with pedestrian-approach alarm, and a rear camera that monitors the trailing cable. The complete power supply package includes cable reel, junction box, cable-handling vehicle, mobile energy storage and mobile generator. Other excavators in the larger sizes at the event include the SY1650E, a 165 t hydraulic mining excavator driven by a 630 kW electric motor and supplied from a 6 kV grid connection. It suits mines where the excavator stays in one working area for long periods. SANY also supplies the cable reels, cable-handling vehicles and mobile power units needed to run it. Then it is also showcasing the 87 t class SY870E, also built for mining and coming in two versions: cable-fed, or dual-power with a 207 kWh battery added. A 400 kW permanent-magnet motor runs on a 1 kV electric drive system. A spring-loaded reel pays out and rewinds up to 35 m of cable automatically, and the dual-power version travels more than 2 km on battery alone to move between working areas. The machine can be fed from the grid or from a mobile power unit. Finally in ancillary machines is the STG335E, a 34.8 t battery-electric motor grader built for mine haul roads. Its 528 kWh battery charges in about an hour and supports six to ten hours of work, enough for sites that run 16 hours or more a day. An automated manual transmission with energy recovery is matched to the electric drive. title: Reinstated Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang must still face China congressional and Senate Banking committees
zh_title: 复职的英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋仍必须面对中国国会和参议院银行委员会
summary: 尽管英伟达本周早些时候在唐纳德·特朗普总统的压力下恢复了黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，但美国众议院和参议院议员表示，他仍然必须在他们深入调查时出庭作证。中国问题特别委员会在 X 上发布消息称，英伟达首席执行官和公司总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特 (Tim Teter) 将于 12 月 1 日和 2 日分别面对该委员会，而彭博社报道称，詹森将在强大的美国参议院银行、住房和城市事务委员会面前公开作证。
content:
尽管英伟达本周早些时候在唐纳德·特朗普总统的压力下恢复了黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，但美国众议院和参议院议员表示，他仍然必须在他们深入调查时出庭作证。中国特别委员会在 X 上发布消息称，Nvidia 首席执行官和公司总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特 (Tim Teter) 将于 12 月 1 日和 2 日分别面对该委员会，而彭博社报道称，Jensen 将于 12 月 3 日在强大的美国参议院银行、住房和城市事务委员会公开作证。 关于黄仁勋复任 NVIDIA 中国特别委员会主席 John Moolenaar (R-MI) 的声明，Rick Crawford常设情报特别委员会 (R-AR) 和外交事务委员会的布莱恩·马斯特 (R-FL) 就 NVIDIA 董事会恢复黄仁勋的职务联合发布了以下声明：“NVIDIA 董事会的简短内部调查和黄仁勋的恢复并没有消除国家安全威胁和必须解决的问题。黄仁勋和蒂姆·泰特已确认，他们将按原计划出席 12 月 1 日和 12 月 2 日的采访录音。
我们仍然致力于就 NVIDIA 产品大规模走私、这些产品被转移到中国军事目的以及它们在推进我们最重要对手的人工智能能力方面发挥的关键作用等问题找到答案。” 2026 年 11 月 23 日 “NVIDIA 董事会的简短内部调查和黄仁勋的复职并不能消除国家安全威胁和必须解决的问题，”中国特别委员会表示。“黄仁勋和蒂姆·泰特已确认他们将出席 12 月 1 日的采访录音并按原计划于 12 月 2 日举行。我们仍然致力于找到有关 NVIDIA 产品大规模走私、这些产品被转用于中国军事目的以及它们在提升我们最重要对手的人工智能能力方面所发挥的关键作用的答案。”众议院中国委员会、外交委员会和情报委员会主席于 11 月 7 日首次召集英伟达首席执行官召开闭门会议，讨论有关他与一名疑似中国间谍有染的指控，议员们称这“引发了重大的国家安全担忧”。就在一天后，詹森承认有外遇，尽管他没有提及第三者的名字。在英伟达董事会恢复黄先生的职务的同一天，参议院银行委员会主席蒂姆·斯科特表示，詹森将出现在委员会面前，并在有关美国对先进人工智能硬件出口管制的听证会上公开作证。
黄仁勋面临的最大问题之一是涉及 Nvidia 产品的芯片转移的大量报道。美国于 2022 年首次对 Nvidia H100 芯片实施出口管制，因为担心中国将其用于军事目的。然而，有传言称，只要你知道最早在 2023 年向谁询问，就可以轻松地在中国获得这些芯片，尽管 Nvidia 首席执行官在一次被问到这一问题时回答说：“没有任何芯片转移的证据”。此外，与他有染的人之一爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 据称在确保价值超过 75 亿美元的非法 Nvidia GPU 进口到中国方面发挥了重要作用。众所周知，黄仁勋本人反对出口管制，并称其失败。中国会议特别委员会

Even though Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO earlier this week under pressure from President Donald Trump , members of the U.S. House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate say that he must still appear before them and testify as they dive into their respective investigations. The Select Committee on China posted on X that the Nvidia CEO and the company’s general counsel, Tim Teter, are set to face the committee on December 1 and 2, respectively, while Bloomberg reports that Jensen will publicly testify before the powerful U.S. Senate Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs on December 3. Statement on Jensen Huang's Reinstatement at NVIDIAChairmen John Moolenaar (R-MI) of the Select Committee on China, Rick Crawford (R-AR) of the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and Brian Mast (R-FL) of the Foreign Affairs Committee jointly released the following statement concerning Jensen Huang's reinstatement by NVIDIA’s board:“The NVIDIA board’s brief internal investigation and reinstatement of Jensen Huang do not erase the national security threats and questions that must be addressed. Jensen Huang and Tim Teter have confirmed they will appear for their transcribed interviews on December 1 and December 2 as previously planned. We remain committed to getting answers on the mass smuggling of NVIDIA products, their diversion for Chinese military purposes, and their key role in advancing our foremost adversary’s AI capabilities." November 23, 2026 “The NVIDIA board’s brief internal investigation and reinstatement of Jensen Huang do not erase the national security threats and questions that must be addressed,” the Select Committee on China said. “Jensen Huang and Tim Teter have confirmed they will appear for their transcribed interviews on December 1 and December 2 as previously planned. We remain committed to getting answers on the mass smuggling of NVIDIA products, their diversion for Chinese military purposes, and their key role in advancing our foremost adversary’s AI capabilities.” The chairpersons of the House Committees on China, Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence first called upon the Nvidia CEO on November 7 for a closed-door meeting to discuss the allegations that he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, which lawmakers say “raise significant national security concerns.” Just a day later, Jensen admitted to having an affair , although he did not mention the name of the third party. On the same day that the Nvidia board reinstated Mr. Huang, Senate Banking Committee Chairperson Tim Scott said that Jensen will appear before the committee and publicly testify during a hearing about U.S. export controls on advanced AI hardware. One of the biggest issues that Jensen Huang is facing is the numerous reports of chip diversion involving Nvidia’s products. The U.S. first put export controls on Nvidia H100 chips in 2022 as it feared that China was using it for military purposes. However, there have been rumors that you could easily get these chips in China as long as you know who to ask as early as 2023, even though the Nvidia CEO answered, “There’s no evidence of any chip diversion,” when asked about it one time. Furthermore, Alice Huang, one of the people that he had an affair with , was allegedly instrumental in securing over $7.5 billion worth of illicit Nvidia GPU imports to China . Jensen Huang himself is known to be against export controls and has called them a failure . The Select Committee on China’s meeting with the Nvidia CEO will be conducted privately. Although there is going to be a transcription of the interview, it’s unclear if and when the data will be released publicly. On the other hand, the Senate Banking Committee hearing is open to the public and will be broadcast live and online, which will also be the first time that Jensen Huang will face a formal congressional hearing.

content:
2022 年 2 月 4 日，也门西北部哈贾省哈拉德地区的也门政府军成员。照片：新华社 沙特阿拉伯组建阿拉伯国家联盟击败也门胡塞武装 11 年后，利雅得基本上是独自与他们作战。其前合作伙伴已撤回或限制对保卫沙特领土的支持。其支持的也门军队目前正在向临时首都亚丁撤退。 11月15日，政府军宣布从杜巴布机场和曼德海峡周边地区撤军，以保卫亚丁。这次撤退放弃了也门黎明行动的主要成果，该行动于 10 月 5 日开始，旨在从胡塞武装手中夺回领土。胡塞武装推进至距亚丁60公里以内。第二天，萨勒曼国王发布皇家命令，将作为联合部队指挥官负责监督联军行动的法赫德·萨勒曼中将调任顾问职务。法耶兹·鲁瓦利将军接任代理司令，同时保留总参谋长职务。多年来，该联盟一直在萎缩。阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林、科威特和卡塔尔于 2015 年签署，埃及、约旦和苏丹也表示其军队参与其中。卡塔尔于2017年因与利雅得和阿布扎比的外交争端而被暂停。 2019年，摩洛哥暂停参赛并召回驻利雅得大使。
阿联酋开始撤出约 10,000 名士兵，而为联军提供大部分地面部队的苏丹则将其特遣队人数从 15,000 人削减至 5,000 人。最后的突破发生在 2025 年 12 月 30 日，当时联军飞机袭击了穆卡拉港，击中了利雅得所说的阿联酋为南部分裂分子运送的武器。当沙特阿拉伯7月组建红海海上联盟时，阿联酋撤出了剩余部队并置身事外。英国下议院图书馆称联盟已经分裂。这种分裂在保卫也门南部的部队中也很明显。南方过渡委员会发言人批评政府将反胡塞武装纳入其指挥的努力，并重申该委员会要求就南部分裂问题进行全民公投。自7月战争重新爆发以来，外国军事部署的重点是保卫沙特领土。英国正在驾驶英国皇家空军台风战机在沙特城市上空执行防御任务。埃及议会授权军事支持，总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西表示，军事支持仅限于保护王国。土耳其和巴基斯坦同意根据麦加防御条约向沙特阿拉伯快速部署部队。土耳其外交部长哈坎·菲丹表示，“这不是一项进攻性协议”。 7月，利雅得告诉华盛顿，它可以独自对付胡塞武装。到9月，王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼已两次致电唐纳德·特朗普总统，敦促对胡塞武装发动袭击。
特朗普拒绝了这一请求，并同意提供情报和目标数据。由于导弹拦截弹所剩无几，沙特阿拉伯还向法国、英国、巴基斯坦和埃及请求防空支持。沙特阿拉伯依赖空中力量，并将其袭击描述为保护沙特平民和基础设施。胡塞武装袭击迫使利雅得将其旗舰“未来投资倡议”会议推迟至2027年。沙特的轰炸行动在11月达到最严重的程度，而胡塞武装继续围困塔伊兹并袭击利雅得。向亚丁撤退使胡塞武装

【原文 English Original】
Members of Yemeni government forces in Harad District, Hajjah Province, northwestern Yemen, on Feb. 4, 2022. Photo: Xinhua Eleven years after Saudi Arabia assembled a coalition of Arab states to defeat Yemen’s Houthis, Riyadh is fighting them largely alone. Its former partners have withdrawn or limited their support to defending Saudi territory. The Yemeni forces it backs are now retreating toward Aden, the interim capital. On November 15, government-aligned forces announced they were withdrawing from Dhubab airport and the area around the Bab al-Mandeb Strait to defend Aden. The retreat gave up the main gain of Operation Dawn of Yemen, which began on October 5 as an offensive to retake territory from the Houthis. Houthi forces advanced to within 60 kilometers of Aden. The next day, King Salman issued a royal order transferring Lt. Gen. Fahd al-Salman, who oversaw coalition operations as commander of the Joint Forces, to an advisory post. Gen. Fayyad al-Ruwaili took over as acting commander while retaining his duties as chief of the general staff. The coalition had been shrinking for years. The United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar signed on in 2015, and Egypt, Jordan and Sudan said their forces were involved. Qatar was suspended in 2017 during its diplomatic dispute with Riyadh and Abu Dhabi. In 2019, Morocco suspended its participation and recalled its ambassador to Riyadh. The UAE began pulling out its roughly 10,000 troops, and Sudan, which had supplied much of the coalition’s ground force, cut its contingent from 15,000 to 5,000 . The final break came on December 30, 2025, when coalition aircraft struck Mukalla port, hitting what Riyadh said was an Emirati weapons shipment for southern separatists. The UAE withdrew its remaining forces and stayed out when Saudi Arabia formed a Red Sea maritime alliance in July. Britain’s House of Commons Library describes the coalition as having split . That split is also evident among the forces defending southern Yemen. A spokesman for the Southern Transitional Council criticized the government’s efforts to bring anti-Houthi forces under its command and repeated the council’s demand for a referendum on southern secession. Since the war resumed in July, foreign military deployments have focused on defending Saudi territory. Britain is flying RAF Typhoons on defensive missions over Saudi cities. Egypt’s parliament authorized military support, which President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi said would be limited to protecting the kingdom. Turkey and Pakistan agreed under the Mecca defense pact to the rapid deployment of forces to Saudi Arabia. Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said that “this is not an offensive agreement.” In July, Riyadh told Washington it could handle the Houthis on its own. By September, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman had called President Donald Trump twice to urge strikes on the Houthis. Trump declined the request and agreed to provide intelligence and targeting data. Saudi Arabia, running low on missile interceptors, also asked France, Britain, Pakistan and Egypt for air defense support. Saudi Arabia has relied on airpower and describes its strikes as a defense of Saudi civilians and infrastructure. Houthi attacks forced Riyadh to postpone its flagship Future Investment Initiative conference to 2027. The Saudi bombing campaign reached its heaviest level in November, while the Houthis continued to besiege Taiz and strike Riyadh. The retreat toward Aden gives the Houthis control of the Yemeni shore of the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. The group declared an embargo on shipping to and from Saudi ports on July 20 and later attacked tankers operated by the Saudi state carrier Bahri. Traffic through the strait grew 17% in October, but the European Union’s Aspides naval mission lacks enough warships to meet demand for escorts. U.S. officials said Washington would stay out as long as the Houthis did not disrupt non-Saudi shipping. Defense analyst Wolfgang Pusztai said Saudi Arabia could absorb Houthi attacks for an extended period. He also considered an assault on Aden unlikely because of the urban fighting it would require. That points to a stalemate in which the Houthis hold their territorial gains and Saudi-linked ships remain at risk. With the military conflict between Iran and the United States already restricting traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, an Iranian ally now holds the Yemeni shore of another chokepoint for Gulf oil. The post Yemen’s Anti-Houthi Coalition Collapses: Allies Gone, Commander Replaced, Houthis 60 km From Aden appeared first on The Gateway Pundit .

content:
这名无家可归男子被指控在唐人街可怕地勒死一名 62 岁妇女并对其进行性侵犯，他是一名来自洪都拉斯的非法移民，自去年以来，他在纽约市多次躲避 ICE 的拘留，并逮捕了 38 人。执法消息人士告诉《纽约邮报》，25 岁​​的亚历克斯·阿伦德·弗洛伦蒂诺·马尔多纳多 (Alex Alender Florentino Maldonado) 被指控于周六在唐人街的公寓内杀害金宇，一天前，金宇因另一起盗窃案被释放，不得保释，这要归功于该市的庇护政策，执法消息人士告诉《纽约邮报》。 “在这起案件中，被告在下午入室盗窃了一名 62 岁妇女在唐人街的公寓，似乎让她遭受了不必要的性接触，然后让她脸朝下躺在自己的血里，不穿裤子，”助理地区检察官乔纳森·卡法尼奥 (Jonathan Carfagno) 在马尔多纳多的提审中告诉法庭。 “她的脚踝上穿着内衣，她的拉链运动衫打开，露出了她的乳房、阴道和臀部，”检察官补充道。 《华盛顿邮报》报道称，“卡法尼奥说，余的室友在袭击期间回到家中并与凶手对峙，他在恐怖袭击中脑出血。他正在医院康复。”卡法尼奥说：“赶到现场的警官发现这名 66 岁的男性脸部有割伤，脖子上有红色斑点，与被勒死的情况相符。” “在公寓内，他们看到女受害者的脖子上有结扎痕迹。她的脸和嘴唇明显肿胀。
Her complexion had turned purple.”据《华盛顿邮报》报道，马尔多纳多于 2022 年 3 月 11 日从墨西哥非法越境进入美国，并立即被亚利桑那州尤马的边境巡逻人员逮捕，然后被驱逐出境。马尔多纳多后来重新入境并开始犯罪狂潮，其中包括去年初在南卡罗来纳州以轻罪盗窃罪被捕。从 2025 年 2 月左右开始，他到达纽约市后，因入室盗窃、持有毒品、盗窃、逃票和其他交通违法行为等罪名被捕 38 次。马尔多纳多在过去一年中至少缺席了十几次出庭，而且从未因轻微指控而被关押，这些指控通常会导致缓刑。在得知多次被捕后，移民和海关执法局的执法和驱逐行动于 8 月 20 日将他的案件移交进一步调查。从 3 月 18 日开始，该机构至少派出了四名拘留者来拘留他，一直持续到谋杀案发生之日，随后又派出了第五名拘留者。消息人士告诉该报，纽约的庇护法限制当地与联邦移民当局的合作，导致这些被拘留者无法得到尊重。 “没有人应该感到惊讶，但这并没有减少令人沮丧的事情。政客什么时候才能开始关心无辜受害者？如果可能的话，当你任命法律援助律师担任法官时，情况只会变得更糟，”一位消息人士告诉《华盛顿邮报》。
美国国土安全部在向《华盛顿邮报》提供的一份声明中表示，“我们呼吁纽约尊重他的拘留者。他的所有主张都将由移民法官审理，他将接受正当程序。本届政府不会忽视法治。”纽约市庇护法允许非法外国人躲避多个 ICE 拘留者后，逮捕了 38 名非法外国人，并在自己的家中对老妇实施性侵犯并勒死，该帖子首先出现在 The Gateway Pundit 上。

【原文 English Original】
The homeless man charged in the horrific Chinatown strangulation and sexual assault of a 62-year-old woman is an illegal alien from Honduras who racked up 38 arrests in New York City since last year while repeatedly dodging ICE detainers. Alex Alender Florentino Maldonado, 25, is accused of killing Jin Yu inside her apartment in Chinatown on Saturday after he was released without bail just one day earlier on a separate theft case, thanks to the city’s sanctuary policies, law enforcement sources told the New York Post . “In this case, the defendant burglarized a 62-year-old woman’s Chinatown apartment in the middle of the afternoon, seemingly subjected her to unwanted sexual contact, and then left her lying face down in her own blood without pants,” Assistant District Attorney Jonathan Carfagno told the court at Maldonado’s arraignment. “Underwear around her ankle, her zip-up sweatshirt open, exposing her breasts, vagina and buttocks,” the prosecutor added. The Post reports, “Carfagno said Yu’s roommate, who arrived home during the attack and confronted the alleged killer, suffered a brain hemorrhage during the horror. He is recovering in the hospital.” “Responding officers observed the 66-year-old male with a laceration to his face and red blotches on the neck consistent with being strangled,” Carfagno said. “Inside the apartment, they saw that the female victim’s neck contained ligature marks. Her face and lips had swelled substantially. Her complexion had turned purple.” According to The Post, Maldonado illegally crossed into the United States from Mexico on March 11, 2022, and was promptly apprehended by Border Patrol agents in Yuma, Arizona, before being removed from the country. Maldonado later reentered and began a crime spree that included a misdemeanor petty larceny arrest in South Carolina early last year. Once in New York City, starting around February 2025, he was arrested 38 times for crimes ranging from burglary, drug possession, theft, fare-beating, and other transit infractions. Maldonado skipped court appearances at least a dozen times in the past year and was never locked up for the minor charges, which typically resulted in suspended sentences. Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s Enforcement and Removal Operations referred his case for further investigation on August 20 after learning of the repeated arrests. The agency issued at least four detainers to hold him in custody beginning March 18 and continuing until the day of the murder, with a fifth issued afterward. New York’s sanctuary laws, which restrict local cooperation with federal immigration authorities, prevented those detainers from being honored, the sources told the paper. “No one should be surprised, but that doesn’t make it any less frustrating. When will politicians start caring about innocent victims? And it will only get worse, if possible, when you appoint Legal Aid attorneys as judges,” one source told The Post. The Department of Homeland Security said in a statement provided to The Post, “We are calling on New York to honor his detainer. All his claims will be heard by an immigration judge, and he will receive due process. This administration will not ignore the rule of law.” The post Illegal Alien With 38 Arrests Sexually Assaults and Strangles Elderly Woman to Death in Her Own Home After NYC Sanctuary Laws Let Him Dodge Multiple ICE Detainers appeared first on The Gateway Pundit .

title: Felicity Solar showcases 20 kWh low-voltage residential battery
